name: AIO Codex
author: Finderio

sections.description:
The AIO Codex plugin provides an intuitive way to create, manage, and use custom shortcodes in WordPress. Designed for simplicity and versatility, AIO Codex eliminates the need for coding, enabling anyone to insert dynamic content seamlessly across their site.

Shortcodes are a vital part of WordPress functionality, and with AIO Codex, you can generate and use them without ever editing functions.php. Whether you need to display custom text, media, forms, or advanced dynamic data, this plugin is the ultimate shortcode creation solution for WordPress users.

Why Choose AIO Codex?

  • No Coding Required: Create shortcodes easily without technical expertise.
  • Reusable Components: Save and reuse your shortcode content across posts and pages.
  • Dynamic Attributes: Add customizable parameters for flexible usage.
  • Fast and Lightweight: Optimized for performance and reliability.

Key Features:

  • Build custom shortcodes effortlessly.
  • Add support for parameters to customize shortcode outputs.
  • Use shortcodes in widgets, posts, pages, or templates.
  • User-friendly dashboard for managing all your shortcodes.
  • Fully compatible with multisite WordPress setups.

This plugin is ideal for bloggers, developers, and website owners looking to streamline content display and reuse with minimal effort.

How to Use AIO Codex

  1. Access the AIO Codex menu in your WordPress dashboard after activation.
  2. Click on Add New Shortcode and input a unique ID.
  3. Add your desired content (text, HTML, or dynamic elements) and set attributes as needed.
  4. Save the shortcode and use it anywhere on your site with [aiocodex id="shortcode_id"].

Basic Shortcode Example: [aiocodex id="123"]

License

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to the WordPress admin area, navigate to Plugins -> Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate Plugin to enable AIO Codex.
sections.faq:
What is a shortcode?

A shortcode is a small piece of code enclosed in square brackets (e.g., [aiocodex id="1234"]) that allows you to display dynamic content anywhere on your site.

How do I create a shortcode?

With AIO Codex, navigate to the plugin dashboard, create a unique ID, add content, and save the shortcode. Then use it across your site.

Can I add parameters to my shortcodes?

Yes, AIO Codex supports dynamic attributes. You can add parameters like [aiocodex id="123"] for flexible functionality.
